entries.title: [SEC] 01 · Enrich IP (sub)
entries.use_case: Enrich an IP from several reputation services and return one verdict.

entries.title: [OPS] 10 · Monitor story health and credits
entries.use_case: Sweep every production story for failures, silence and credit burn, and propose fixes for a human to approve.
entries.credit_estimate_basis: set at design: sweep runs/day × observed triage and critic credits × 30

entries.title: [KIT] 00 · Launch Storyworks
entries.use_case: Provision a customer's repository and tenant from one kickoff Page, keep the tracker in sync between git and Records, and dispatch the tool-less runtime crew.
entries.credit_estimate_basis: set at design: planner, brief_writer and retro_writer runs/day × credits/run observed in dev × 30, plus the two provider probes

milestones.title: Day 1: Storyworks is provisioned and safe to build in
milestones.criteria:
- The setup report is ok, or partial with every failure explained
- The repository and the tenant config commit exist
- The Tines Agent Skills are pushed
- The Record types and Resources exist, including the ops trio's six Record types
- The provider probe is ok, or tool_calls_unreliable is acknowledged
- /tines-connect works in at least one editor
- K2 is confirmed, or phase-gate.sh is known to deny all /mcp calls until it is
- Team memberships are checked: no builder account holds an Editor or Admin role in the prod (ops) team
- Story #1 has passed G0 and discovery
- Branch protection, CODEOWNERS and the GitHub environments are set
- The provisioning token is revoked or expiring

milestones.title: Week 1: the first stories are live and the tracker round trip works
milestones.criteria:
- Story #1 is live through G5
- Story #2 is live and is every production story's recipient
- [OPS] 10, the ops sweep, is live
- The tracker round trip is proven: a Tines-side G0 reached main by PR
- review.yml runs (called by storyline.yml)
- Token alerts are set on the kit's agents
- Two or three more stories are in design or build

milestones.title: Week 4: the lifecycle runs end to end, including improve
milestones.criteria:
- At least 3 stories are live, including one mode-3-agent with an output schema, a Trigger, a token alert, a skill and a budget line
- The ops sweep is running with baselines
- The first retro is closed and at least one eval case has graduated to regression
- One skill change has shipped via skills.yml
- The dashboard is in use
- Credits have been reviewed against estimates
- G7 dates are set
